scope: Run the pinned Round 19 C3 linegeom.py and linetests.py unchanged on the 56 exact LP2-00..55 JPEGs and pinned canonical rune text. Compare saved source results and independently recount rows, channel screens, bit-decoder controls, and their limits.

source_rules.geometry_pages: LP2-00..55, each image classified by source component-height and grouping code
source_rules.bimodality_gate: source GMM separation >=2.0 standard deviations and delta BIC >10
source_rules.bit_decode: eight image/canon channels, threshold at each channel median, 5/8 bit packings with forward/reverse and phase0..7, 2000 source-seeded shuffles per channel; source bar p<0.001
source_rules.control_C3a: 64-bit CICADA33 plant at 0.5,1,2,3,4,6,8 times observed fill-ratio SD; require >=95% bit recovery and GMM separation >=2.0
source_rules.control_C3b: noise-free planted ASCII in bit channel must beat the same 2000-shuffle bar

interpretation_rule: If C3a never reaches 95%, do not present a negative as excluding even a strong line-fill payload. Report observed source scans and sensitivity failure separately. Do not infer an encoder, covert-message absence, or source's general verdict beyond exact tested channels.
